recommendation: Keep this source fix. It completes the original refactor for the paired response example and leaves no discovered USSG/DataElement references in the current active example sources.
issue_request: FHIR-13444 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and asked to refactor the USSG Questionnaire example because DataElement had been removed, explicitly naming the USSG Questionnaire and QuestionnaireResponse example pages.
initial_application: Commit f7bcd0a0a8dda76fc89e07041ba4cae3b0e38c83 mentioned GF#13444 and removed the USSG ConceptMap entry whose targetUri pointed at http://hl7.org/fhir/us/sdc/DataElement. A later commit, fd340a3ba159243577af5aeb1c956986d214c206, changed the Questionnaire example's item.definition URLs from http://loinc.org/fhir/DataElement/... to http://loinc.org/rdf#..., but the paired QuestionnaireResponse example still carried 137 DataElement definition URLs.
additional_context: The current build configuration keeps Questionnaire and QuestionnaireResponse active while DataElement is commented out in source/fhir.ini. The USSG examples are listed in the active Questionnaire and QuestionnaireResponse example lists, so the remaining response URIs are current core source, not stale generated output or out-of-build source. Jira search found only this issue for the USSG/DataElement/Questionnaire combination, and direct Zulip/Confluence searches found no FHIR-13444 discussion or conflicting work-group record.
reconciliation: Replaced all 137 USSG QuestionnaireResponse item.definition values that used http://loinc.org/fhir/DataElement/... with matching http://loinc.org/rdf#... LOINC URIs. The change leaves linkIds, answers, and questionnaire structure unchanged and removes the obsolete DataElement resource path from the current response example.
